paragraphs: greymatter is a CRM for higher education student lifecycle management, covering recruitment, admissions and student success from one platform. Implementation can be phased, with institutions typically starting in a functional area such as Recruit and scaling up to another area later.

For recruitment the product offers automated communication campaigns, event management, social media integration, territory management, recruiter dashboards and analytics. The admissions workflow routes submissions for review, scores eligibility automatically, and releases decisions in encrypted offer letters detailing financial aid and awards. A student portal supports degree planning, course registration, advising and attendance tracking, and monitors at-risk students. Continuing education and B2B partnerships are handled through course registrations, payments and order processing.

greymatter operates with an institution's SIS and is integrated with Office 365, including Word and Excel templates. Reporting and dashboards can be defined for the institution, departments or individual users, with analysis using Microsoft Power BI on the Dynamics 365 platform.

quote.text: greymatter manages the entire student journey, eliminating data silos and building a 360 approach to student success.
